items.text: Ca-Caw! Just pushed a brand new update to version 1.0.21!
Something you might want to check out is a new Gameplay Setting called "Wall Bounce"

This lets you disable bouncing off of walls and making the squeaky sound. Personally, I love the way it works by default, but thought it might make flying around easier for some folks based on the feedback we got. Here's what it looks like side by side On and Off:
Let us know what you think.

notes.title: Here's the full changelog since last patch notes

items.text: Added Wall Bounce setting and slightly re-scaled things
Updated default joystick mappings for Playstation 4 controllers
Added localization support for Control Mapper
Crow Customizer: adjusted text position to prevent button overlap
Crow Customizer will now refresh more (fixes potential bug where it might not show unlocked decors)
Slight text changes and clarifications in dialogues
Quaint Town: added extra briefcase guy for safety and made the task / achievement more forgiving
Egypt: hid confusing keyhole on sphinx
Egypt: changed number of diamonds needed to be stolen to 4
Egypt: added collider under diamond boat to prevent diamonds getting lost under it
Egypt: added a hint about lantern making tornadoes go away
Ponyhawk now mention races are optional
Edgar: added extra glow around first window to hint players what to do a bit more
Camp: added extra flashlight before the Hedgehog House as backup
Camp: fixed first fireplace potentially not showing fire
Fixed potential softlock on start of Fantasy and CraftWorld when holding cancel button during loading screen
Moon: fixed crystal detector not showing up when first crystal quest completed and level restarted
Moon: ship core detection box increased size to prevent losing core when clipping into the stand
We're listing to all the feedback and updating the game as we speak! Here's a list of changes in latest patch:
Features
Added an "Un-Stuck Crowy" button to Pause Menu on off chance you get stuck (it teleports you to where you started the level)
Tweaks
Toned down volume of the Level Completed / Hat Obtained music
Decreased number of baby squirrels needed to bing back to mom and made them easier to see
Craftworld: made drying hoomans quest more forgiving
Camp: Adjusted position of some campfires on
Made cat water collider bigger on Quaint Town to make it easier to soak
Added "Controller Recommended" prompt at start
Bugfixes
Fixed Fantasy level end cutsene potentially breaking if you Alt-Tab
Fixed Cloudy falling thru the floor when dropped when standing on the ground
Fixed some text typos and adjusted text positions for better readability
Egypt: made gems harder to lose and adjusted some colliders
NEXT UP: We're working on adding some more control settings and rebindable keys, so stay tuned!
Update: the Key Binding is IN! Still bit rudimentary and we're working on improving that, but it's in there if you want to use it early :D
Ca-Caw!
